exercises.question: Which sentence correctly imagines an alternative? [¿Cuál imagina correctamente una alternativa?]
options: Si tuviera otra oportunidad, cambiaría mi decisión. [If I had another opportunity, I would change my decision.]
Si tengo otra oportunidad, cambiaría mi decisión. [If I have another opportunity, I would change my decision.]
Si tuve otra oportunidad, cambiaré mi decisión. [If I had another opportunity, I will change my decision.]
